research.facts:
Misiorowski Cy Young / Velocity
**Confirmed facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Full name: Jacob Misiorowski (NOTE: pipeline has used "Misiorowski" without first name; Jacob is correct; avoid confusion with Freddy Peralta, different pitcher now with Mets)
- Record: 14-5 (confirmed per pipeline context; one source showed 13-5 but that was an older article)
- ERA: approximately 1.73 (slightly above pipeline's 1.68 — consistent ballpark)
- Cy Young odds: -1400 per FanDuel/Bleacher Nation as of mid-to-late August (significant move from prior pipeline's -550)
- Runners-up: Chris Sale at +750, Cristopher Sanchez at +1100
- 200 Ks reached in 129.1 innings — second-fewest innings ever by an MLB pitcher to reach 200 Ks
- Velocity dip: average fastball from 100.5 mph to 98.7 mph. Only 9 of 95 pitches hit 100+ mph in a recent start (vs. Mets)
- Trevor Plouffe (former Twins) publicly called on Brewers to monitor workload — first full MLB season, has nearly doubled prior-season pitch total
- Next start: projected September 2 vs. Cubs at Wrigley (one source; prior pipeline said Aug 31 — use the more conservative Sept 2 framing)
**Source notes:**
